profile_text.body:
Lokalise is a continuous localization and translation management platform founded in 2016 and headquartered in Newark, Delaware. The company describes itself as a system that connects localization workflows, standardizes execution, and integrates into development pipelines so that teams can ship localized products more quickly. Its platform supports role-based access control across both the web interface and its API, applying the same permissions model throughout.

The company's primary AI product, Lokalise AI, sits within the localization and translation category and is noted as UK-hosted. The platform uses AI to apply approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary in order to keep translations consistent across languages, and it offers Custom AI Profiles along with surrounding context and metadata to help the AI produce accurate output. A feature called AI Scoring evaluates translation quality automatically, routing only low-confidence results for human review. Lokalise also describes dynamic LLM routing, in which the platform selects and connects to what it considers the best-fit large language model based on language, content, and context, without requiring repeated configuration from the user.

The held facts show 12 instances of Delaware legal exposure, consistent with the company's Newark, Delaware headquarters and its likely incorporation there. No litigation cases, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
